The '''Ugarra Dunes''' was an area in the [[Drydust Crescent]], the region of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that lay north of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Ila]].
